faqs.question: Is Power BI suitable for small businesses?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Power BI offers various pricing tiers, including a free option to get started.

faqs.question: How difficult is it to implement Power BI?
faqs.answer: With our guidance, implementation is streamlined. Basic dashboards can be created in days, not months.

faqs.question: Can Power BI connect to our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Yes, Power BI connects to hundreds of data sources including SQL, Excel, SharePoint, and custom APIs.
